evidence.definitions: v1: revenue=sum(item sale_price); units=item rows; customers=distinct user_id; orders=distinct order_id. Both order and item status exclude Cancelled/Returned. Dates use order_items.created_at, UTC [start,end). Current status, not historical snapshots. Churn proxy: 60-day inactivity share at start/end (exclusive as-of). Eligible = first authorized purchase before as-of minus N days; inactive = last purchase before that cutoff. Empty denominator is undefined. Not newly churned customers in a month. Brand breakdown capped at 50 largest eligible cohorts, preserving both snapshots.
